review: Independent final documentation review: connected virtual-user lifecycle

acceptance.scope: Five groups, 18 GUI observations, 19 named outcomes, three original frames, three distinct owned x64 targets; 183 tests, formatting, strict Clippy, x64/i686 builds; i686 was not executed.

reviewed_boundaries: Connected mutations reuse the 23-tool schema and require current session-control permission, expected roster revision, automatic routing, a nonempty fully covered PID scope, active permitted users, and permitted current recipients.

A clone remains unchecked and GUI-session-owned until explicitly granted; reconnect is required after policy Apply. Creator Stop exception is limited to the exact clone created by that still-connected client.
Preflight rejection preserves state; authorized native cleanup may be partial. EOF clears the creator receipt but not the clone. Scheduled tap-release filtering is source-reviewed only.
Historical failed aggregate artifacts remain unchanged. No i686 execution, hardware, broad application compatibility, same-process isolation, or full Ultra/UX parity claim.
